loading.reason: The compact activity-stripe cell waits silently during its initial poll rather than replacing the button with a loading banner.

empty.reason: A clean status omits the dirty-count badge and communicates cleanliness in the accessible label.

evidence.quote: const clean = status !== null && status.available && status.worktreeId !== null && !status.dirty

error.reason: The compact cell cannot host a full InlineError banner; it exposes unavailable status through its accessible label and StatusDot.
